LESSON: CIRCLES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements
Topic 3.1: Circles
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Circles, part of Measurements in Grade 8 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we determine the circumference of a circle? 2. How do we use sectors of a circle in real-life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss with others and find the circumference of different circular objects in the environment,

2. use cut outs to relate arc length to the circumference of a circle, starting with semicircle, then quarter of a circle etc,

3. draw circles and work their circumference and arc length,

4. use cut outs of sectors of circles from locally available materials and work out the perimeter of the sectors,

5. discuss and make any object with the sector 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss with others and find the circumference of different circular objects in the environment,
2. use cut outs to relate arc length to the circumference of a circle, starting with semicircle, then quarter of a circle etc,
3. draw circles and work their circumference and arc length,
4. use cut outs of sectors of circles from locally available materials and work out the perimeter of the sectors,
5. discuss and make any object with the sector 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Circles together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: as the learner discusses and finds the circumference of different circular objects in the

environment.

• Creativity and Imagination: as the learner uses cut outs to relate arc length to the circumference of a circle.

Values

• Integrity: as the learner draws circles of given dimensions and work out their circumference.

• Responsibility: as the learner makes any objects with the sector that can be used in real-life situations.
